description: A direct search UI: query box, bucket/type facets, expand-search, per-result provenance + provider freshness, and loading/error/empty/degraded states. Built on the vrooli-default design kit (react-vite-tailwind adapter).

requirements.title: Faceted search page with provenance + freshness
requirements.description: The UI exposes a query box, bucket/type facets, an expand-search control, per-result provenance (provider + path/id), per-provider freshness/health, and clear loading/error/empty/degraded states.

validation.notes: Submitting a query renders grouped/ranked results with provenance; a degraded provider shows its warning.
Type facets and expand-search re-issue the query with the right parameters.
